# AutoCanvas

> Autonomous multi-tenant social media management platform engineered by DevCenterPoint. Features deterministic AI graphic generation, multi-brand workspace isolation, and idempotent cross-platform publishing across Meta (Facebook Pages, Instagram Professional) and LinkedIn Company Pages.

AutoCanvas eliminates brand identity hallucination by coupling generative AI copywriting with server-side Chromium vector rendering (HTML/SVG templates), ensuring exact brand fonts, colors, and logos.

## Core Documentation & Capabilities
- [Platform Architecture & Philosophy](https://autocanvas.devcenterpoint.com/docs): Multi-tenant database partitioning, distributed queue architecture, and cryptographic token vault.
- [Deterministic Creative Studio](https://autocanvas.devcenterpoint.com/features/creative-studio): How HTML/SVG vector compositing prevents AI logo and typography distortion.
- [Publishing Calendar & Scheduling](https://autocanvas.devcenterpoint.com/features/publishing-calendar): Multi-network scheduling, automated aspect ratio variants (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9), and duplicate post prevention.
- [Agency & Multi-Brand Governance](https://autocanvas.devcenterpoint.com/solutions/agencies): Isolated workspaces, client approval links, and role-based permissions.
- [Transparent Pricing Matrix](https://autocanvas.devcenterpoint.com/pricing): Creator, Agency Pro, and Enterprise subscription tiers with dual USD and local BDT invoicing.
- [Terms of Service](https://autocanvas.devcenterpoint.com/terms): Service level agreements and platform governance.
- [Privacy Policy](https://autocanvas.devcenterpoint.com/privacy): Tenant data protection and zero cross-tenant training guarantees.
